business_problem: Fifth Dimension needed to scale commercial-real-estate document processing and model deployment quickly, lower infrastructure costs, and support AI-first product delivery without stitching together separate cloud, messaging, and runtime stacks.
solution_summary: Fifth Dimension adopted an AI-first Google Cloud architecture that combines messaging, runtime, storage, and model services into a single document-intelligence platform for commercial real estate. Pub/Sub handles chunk-level message processing, Cloud Run scales endpoints up and down for cost and performance efficiency, and Cloud SQL supports the high-availability relational workloads behind the application. On top of that base, Fifth Dimension runs a Gemini platform-based machine-learning stack that uses both Gemini and Anthropic Claude models for training, inference, and experimentation. This stack helped the company absorb surging document demand, shorten deployment cycles from weeks to days, and expand intelligence capabilities without rebuilding the platform underneath them.

solution_components.role: Carries chunk-level message traffic through the document-processing pipeline.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Scales service endpoints up or down to handle varying document and inference demand efficiently.

solution_components.name: Cloud SQL
solution_components.role: Provides high-availability relational storage for the platform's application workloads.

solution_components.name: Gemini platform
solution_components.role: Manages the end-to-end machine-learning lifecycle from training through deployment for Fifth Dimension's AI stack.

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Supplies long-context model capabilities inside Fifth Dimension's commercial-real-estate AI workflows.

solution_components.name: Claude
solution_components.role: Runs alongside Gemini as part of the production machine-learning stack used for document intelligence and reasoning.

data_flow: Commercial-real-estate documents are chunked and moved through Pub/Sub into Cloud Run services, with platform state persisted in Cloud SQL. Gemini platform orchestrates training and deployment for Gemini and Claude models, and the resulting outputs feed Fifth Dimension's document-intelligence products.
business_outcome: Fifth Dimension increased document-processing scale dramatically, lowered infrastructure expense, and shortened model deployment cycles enough to keep pace with surging customer demand in commercial real estate.
